name: Melixie

spells.name: Ant Haul
spells.text:
You reinforce the target's musculoskeletal system to bear more weight. The target can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming Encumbered and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

Spell Effect: Ant Haul

spells.name: Figment
spells.text:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to Create a Diversion with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

Spell Effect: Figment

spells.name: Light
spells.text:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

Spell Effect: Light

---

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

items.name: Speak with Arthropods
items.text: A melixie can communicate with arthropods, such as insects, spiders, scorpions, crabs, and similar invertebrate animals. They can use Diplomacy to make-an-impression on arthropods and request things from arthropods.

items.name: Sugar Rush
items.text: The melixie consumes a large quantity of sugar, honey, nectar, or similar sweets and goes into a frenzied state. The melixie immediately Strides or Flies. For the next 1d4+1 rounds, the melixie is Quickened and can use the additional action only to Stride or Fly. As soon as the rush ends, the melixie is Fatigued for 1 minute.

text:
Melixies are hyperactive insect sprites with legendary sweet tooths, capable of gulping down honey, nectar, sugar, and other sweets in alarming quantities. Melixies have antennae and additional insect features that typically resemble those of bees but sometimes butterflies, moths, ladybugs, or other beetles. Melixies live in a pattern of rapid sweets consumption, incredible productivity in tasks of all sorts, and then a crash to sleep it all off and start again. In their spare time, they love to dance, and some learn a dancelike sign language called Melipatter, allowing them to communicate a full range of information through movement.

---
Elusive, flighty, and ebullient, sprites are what many villagers first imagine when they hear the terms "fey" or "fairy."
